title: Digital Bill of Rights (Charter on the Values and Principles for a Digital Society of Mutual Prosperity)
summary: Charter presented by MSIT and reported to the Cabinet on 25 September 2023 under President Yoon Suk Yeol. It has a preamble and six chapters with 28 articles. Five basic principles cover freedom and rights in the digital environment, fair access and opportunity, a safe and trustworthy digital society, innovation based on autonomy and creativity, and human well-being; later chapters set out rights and the roles of the state, businesses and civil society. It covers digital issues broadly, not only AI. It is a statement of principles meant to guide later laws, including AI legislation, and to inform international digital-norm talks.
